Starscream's documentation allows distribution of Starscream only in unmodified form, forbids charging for any program that includes it in whole or in part, and requires the credit "Starscream 680x0 emulation library by Neill Corlett (corlett@elwha.nrrc.ncsu.edu)". Whether a translated core may be redistributed under these terms has not been settled (docs/LICENSING.md). Until it is, build the package for your own use and do not publish it.
